status: shipped, animated with the M1-02 clip set (greybox clips in ATL and X Games style, not reviewed by skaters)
credits: The author generated this model with Tripo from original concept art. No third-party art is in it.
pipeline: A (Tripo Studio 3D Workspace, Blender cleanup, Draco glTF). Pipeline B (img2character) was not used; see docs/characters/pipeline-comparison-m1-10.md.

steps.tool: Tripo Studio web UI (studio.tripo3d.ai), 3D Workspace, Image to 3D, through Claude in Chrome
steps.settings: HD Model, AI model H3.1 - Best Quality, Generate in Parts off, 8K Texture off
Quad topology, Smart Mesh on, polygon count 9000
steps.result: 9,095 quad faces, 8,494 vertices (17,006 triangles in the GLB)

steps.settings: Rigging type Humanoid, skeleton preset Mixamo
steps.result: 65 joints with the mixamorig: prefix, one skin, no animations

steps.settings: File name marcus-tripo, format GLB, texture resolution 4k, Export Skeleton on

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (background mode), scripts/blender/skater_build.py, which runs scripts/blender/nia_clips.py
actions: Imported the raw GLB. Removed the Tripo empties (Node_0, node_0, RootNode) and the Icosphere bone shape. Kept the world transform of the armature.
Scaled the armature and the mesh by 1.8154 (0.980 m to 1.780 m), centered the skater on x and y, put the wheels on z = 0, and applied the transforms.
Kept the Mixamo rig (65 mixamorig: joints) and the skin weights. The mesh was not decimated (17,006 triangles).
Resized the textures: base color 4096 to 2048, normal 2048 to 1024, roughness-metallic 2048 PNG to 1024. All written as JPEG, quality 88. Set the specular tint to white.
Keyed the 24 M1-02 clips with nia_clips.py on the rig MarcusRig. The rest feet are (0.24, -0.233, 0.045) in armature space; Nia has (0.242, -0.236, 0.03).
Removed 13,417 curves that stay at the rest pose. Exported a GLB with Draco (level 6; quantization: position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12) and all clips.
steps.result: assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb, 2,071,416 bytes, 17,006 triangles, 1 skinned mesh, 65 joints, 1.780 m tall, 24 animations, extensions: KHR_draco_mesh_compression only

steps.command: npx @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 resize assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb --width 1024 --height 1024 && npx @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 draco assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb --quantize-position 14 --quantize-normal 10 --quantize-texcoord 12 --quantize-generic 12
actions: Made the phone variant (#74): the base color texture from 2048 px to 1024 px. The normal and roughness maps were already 1024 px; the tool encoded them again as JPEG.
The resize decoded the Draco meshes. The draco command compressed them again with the M1-01 quantization (position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12). It also welded identical vertices.
No new generation and no credits. The mesh, the rig, the joint names, and the 24 clips are the same as skater.glb (src/render/skater-model.test.js checks them).
steps.result: assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb, 1,493,828 bytes (skater.glb is 2,071,416 bytes), the same triangles, joints, and clips

steps.tool: scripts/skater-lod.mjs (meshoptimizer 1.3.0 simplifyWithAttributes, @gltf-transform/core, functions, and extensions 4.5.1, draco3dgltf 1.5.9)
steps.settings: mode color; target 3000 triangles; target error 0.05; attribute weights normal 0.25, color 1; flags Prune; vertex color = mean of the 9 x 9 texels around the UV, in linear color; Draco sequential, quantization position 14, normal 10, color 8, generic 12
actions: Welded the identical vertices. Baked the base color texture into vertex colors (COLOR_0) and removed the UVs.
Welded the vertices at one position into one vertex (mean normal, mean color, the skin of the first vertex). All vertices at one position had the same skin.
Simplified the mesh with meshoptimizer. The simplifier only removes vertices, so each vertex keeps its position and its JOINTS_0 and WEIGHTS_0 from the source.
Kept the skin: the 65 mixamorig: joints, in the same order, with the same inverse bind matrices. Removed the clips and the textures (the game uses the clips of skater.glb).
steps.result: assets/skaters/marcus/skater-lod1.glb, 60,560 bytes, 3,000 triangles, 1,494 vertices, 65 joints, no animations, no textures

five_views: assets/skaters/marcus/views/ (front, back, left, right, three-quarter), made by e2e/skater-model.spec.js

phone_variant.used_by: the phone tier and phone screens (src/main.js, skaterModelUrl())

lod1_variant.used_by: the far NPC skaters (src/render/npc-skaters-view.js, NPC_DRAW lod1From), bound to the skeleton of skater.glb or skater-1024.glb
